t: Fractional Flow Reserve (FFR) :: Pie medical imaging
s: Fractional Flow Reserve (otherwise known as FFR) is a technique utilised to measure the pressure differences on either side of a coronary artery stenosis. The main intention of this strategy is to determine if blood flow (and therefore oxygen) is being impeded due to a narrowing of the arteries.
